title: Chevron Takes Step Towards Greener Shipping: Details
description: Chevron partners with Mitsui O.S.K. Lines to install wind-assisted propulsion on a new LNG carrier, marking the world's first LNG carrier with this technology. This move supports Chevron's efforts to lower carbon intensity in its shipping operations.

title: Chevron Slams Biden's LNG Export Pause, Touts Natural Gas For AI Growth: Report
description: Chevron CEO criticized the Biden administration's pause on LNG exports, arguing that natural gas is crucial for AI growth and can significantly reduce carbon emissions by replacing coal.

title: Chevron Takes Steps To Reduce Methane Emissions From LNG Carriers
description: Chevron Shipping and Wärtsilä will convert engines on six LNG carriers to reduce methane emissions, aligning with Chevron's carbon goals. The conversion from dual-fuel to spark gas engines will optimize combustion, reducing methane slip and improving efficiency.

title: Chevron-Hess Merger Could Soon Get FTC Approval: Report
description: Chevron's $53 billion merger with Hess may soon receive FTC approval, though arbitration claims from Exxon Mobil could delay the deal until 2025.

title: ExxonMobil Proposes $10B Investment In Nigeria
description: ExxonMobil proposes a $10 billion investment in Nigeria's deep-water oil project, focusing on the Owo project. The company also plans an additional $1.5 billion investment to boost production by 50,000 barrels per day.

title: Chevron, Honeywell Join Forces For AI Breakthrough: Details
description: Chevron and Honeywell have partnered to develop AI-assisted solutions for improving efficiency and safety in refining processes. The collaboration aims to enhance decision-making for operators, optimize operations, and address workforce challenges through AI-powered automation.

title: Chevron Sells $6.5B Assets To Canadian Natural Resources: Details
description: Chevron is selling a $6.5 billion stake in Canadian oil sands and shale assets to Canadian Natural Resources, which will boost the latter's production and reserves. The deal is expected to close in Q4 2024.

title: ExxonMobil & HELLEniQ ENERGY JV Completes First Exploration Phase In Crete, Eyes Next Steps
description: ExxonMobil and HELLEniQ ENERGY have completed the first exploration phase in Crete, gathering 7,789 km of seismic data. The joint venture plans to move forward with the second phase, focusing on 3D seismic data collection to assess potential natural gas deposits.

title: Exxon Mobil's Golden Pass LNG Plant Gets 3-Year Extension Amid Contractor Challenges: Report
description: Exxon Mobil and Qatar Energy's Golden Pass LNG project received a 3-year extension due to delays caused by the bankruptcy of lead contractor Zachry Holdings. The project is expected to significantly increase U.S. LNG capacity.

title: Exxon Mobil Sells $1 Billion in Permian Basin Assets to Focus on Shale: Report
description: Exxon Mobil is selling its conventional oil drilling assets in the Permian Basin for $1 billion to focus on high-value shale production assets. The sale aligns with the company's strategy to prioritize its industry-leading portfolio.

title: Exxon Mobil's Lithium Leap: 100,000 Metric Tons To Fuel LG Chem's US Plant
description: Exxon Mobil signed an MOU to supply LG Chem up to 100,000 metric tons of lithium carbonate for its U.S. cathode plant. Exxon Mobil plans to produce lithium using Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) technology, which is expected to have lower carbon intensity compared to hard rock mining.

title: ExxonMobil Plans $200 Million Expansion To Tackle Plastic Waste: Details
description: ExxonMobil plans to invest over $200 million to expand its advanced recycling operations in Texas, aiming to boost recycling rates and reduce plastic waste. The company aims to achieve a global recycling capacity of 1 billion pounds annually by 2027.
